payload.reason: Replaced by a stronger version of the same request, not withdrawn. The original was written one commit before its own hypothetical came true and so understated its case: it listed 'relaxing the lead lookbehind' among the changes that would slip past the gate, and the very next commit on the same branch, 33e1ffd, did exactly that -- it loosened a clinical-copy guard, was classified clinicalRisk:false by classifyPullRequestFiles, and required no Clinical Governance Preflight. The replacement records that as a demonstration rather than a scenario, which is the difference between a row someone reads and a row someone acts on. No content is dropped.
